investigation.likely_cause: The /data volume on the Subscriber DB server srv-db-01 is 100% full (0.1 GiB free, below the 256 MiB write threshold). The largest folder is /data/txlog_archive at 8.5 GiB, and 8.5 GiB was written across 34 files in the last 15 minutes, which points to a transaction-log archive catch-up run rather than organic database growth. The database is refusing writes, so the bundle and balance APIs, USSD gateway and synthetic sessions, and SMS queues are failing downstream.
